turns.text: which uploads may garbage collection delete
Only abandoned uploads whose reservation expired past grace.
Only a retired generation, never the active one.

uploads.abandoned: bytes of an upload whose worker died before committing its archive entry
uploads.checkpoint: bytes an abandoned upload left that a later checkpoint references
uploads.live: bytes of a new attempt whose reservation has not expired
uploads.foreign: bytes of another domain's abandoned upload in the shared object store

never_landed: bytes reserved by an attempt that died before writing them
lookalike: bytes another system wrote into a managed shard under their own digest
stray: a temporary file another tool left in the object store root

altered.written: different bytes found under the reserved name
